verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party server-side recording or storage-bucket egress feature for MoQ Relay. The only related evidence is a community team (SageOx) that built its own S3 archiver as a subscriber to the relay. That is a user-side workaround on developer building blocks, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket
